propositions: Findings raised on one patchset but not re-emitted on the next are lost to consumers because payloads are keyed by (change_id, revision) and Gerrit emits one code_review artifact per revision only
Non-deterministic recall per run means valid findings can vanish between patchsets, causing bugs to merge and break CI

A prior finding must be carried forward across patchsets when its cited file is unchanged (still-present), and withheld when the file is edited (addressed) or the finding was already carried once (withdrawn)
Carried findings must never raise posture (blocking-to-advisory only) and are capped at 12 items sorted by priority, with empty evidence ineligible
Carried findings must be injected post-Pass-1 into the workflow as standing_findings input without being passed to finders, and marked in Gerrit with origin patchset and decision
Standing items resolve via region_gate.region_for_finding against the prior payload's deps hash, with unresolvable regions defaulting to still-present since the posture clamp can only lower decisions
